title: Jordan's gifted-program childhood and Sky Watcher

tellings.quote: I only know one individual and that is Jordan. Yeah. who has talked about, you know, working on on programs and being in gay programs as a kid.

plain: A witness named Jordan Jose has spoken about being put in gifted programs as a child and working on secret programs, which the title ties to something called Sky Watcher that the telling does not describe. A guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb, himself a witness, says Jordan is the only person he knows who has talked about this, and he names no other source. If true, it would mean children were picked out and trained for hidden projects.
